title: [Bug] Lobe does not support deep thinking feature for ollama deepseek r1 models
body: ### 📦 Environment Docker ### 📌 Version v1.48.0 ### 💻 Operating System macOS ### 🌐 Browser Chrome ### 🐛 Bug Description When running [deepseek-r1:8b](https://ollama.com/library/deepseek-r1) via Ollama, Lobe displays the \ tag in text instead of prompting the `deep thinking` feature as it did when calling the official DeepSeek API. Additionally, there is a padding issue at the top of the message box when displaying the \ tag, see it in the screenshot. ### 📷 Recurrence Steps _No response_ ### 🚦 Expected Behavior _No response_ ### 📝 Additional Information _No response_
